def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Clean sex column - strip whitespace variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Group by sex and calculate mean body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return result.to_dict()
